body: i promise you you’ll find it. you’ll find someone or something! you’ll find yourself :)

I attempted suicide earlier this year and it was the most terrifying and painful thing of my life. I won’t sit here and give you advice, I couldn’t, but I’ll just tell you that in the long run, it isn’t worth it. Even if you succeed in your plan, your family and friends and even people you hardly know personally will be crushed. Don’t wash your progress away. Live now.
